study: The data slope's fourth length: both models at 360,000 updates
kind: pre-registration of two full-size runs that take the server's GPUs only when no other job waits, in the window Daniel opened until Thursday 2026-12-03 07:45 Berlin
why: full_size_data_slope.json measures the gap at 45,000, 90,000 and 180,000 updates. Daniel asked on 2026-11-22 for a scaling law in which the stack does not learn worse with more data, and the window he opened on 2026-11-28 holds a fourth doubling for both models (about 22 hours for the stack and 8 for the Transformer with their scoring). The mixture has 292 M distinct training bytes (enwik8 90 M, C4 134 M, PG-19 68 M), so 360,000 updates (1,475 M bytes) see enwik8's training bytes about 8.2 times, C4's 2.7 times and PG-19's 5.4 times. This length therefore measures longer training on repeated data more than more data, and the reading says so. The two runs have the lowest priority in the queue, so they take no time from registered work.

arms.fsd-st-360k: fsd-st-180k's recipe and read at twice the length: sched/bin/full-pair5.sh stack fsd-st-360k 6e-4 --stack-loop 2,8,2 --pulse-budget 507000 --pool-lifts-ceiling --granule-power 8 --fused-reads with STEPS=360000, FORK=96000 (4/15 of the run, as at every length of the data slope), seed 20001, on the code copy v18o (a418100); 36,263,956 parameters in the long stage.
arms.fsd-tf-360k: fsd-tf-180k's recipe at twice the length: full-pair5.sh transformer fsd-tf-360k 1.2e-3 with STEPS=360000, FORK=96000, seed 20001, on v17l (072eb90); 34,752,000 parameters.
arms.schedule: One cosine over 360,000 updates with 1,000 warm-up updates, each model at the peak rate full_size_rate_pilot chose for 90,000 updates, 4,096 bytes an update from the enwik8, C4 and PG-19 mixture at weights 2:1:1, every other setting as at 180,000.

measure: As full_size_second_seeds.json's primary measure: the stack without fast output synapses at the reach chosen on the first 1,000,000 validation bytes between 2,048 and 8,192, over the full enwik8 test and validation splits as 16 unbroken streams; the Transformer frozen in windows of 2,048 with 2,032 bytes of history; paired piece by piece with experiments/compare_stream_scores.py. Beside it: the data slope's registered measure (the stack taught at 2^24 less the Transformer frozen), the Transformer with fast synapses at 0.07, the pulses a byte, the training times and gap_by_piece.py by context.

reading.(1) the fourth doubling: The gap at 360,000 updates less the gap at 180,000 (fsd-st-180k against fsd-tf-180k, the same measure), on each split. The gap shrinks at this doubling if it falls by at least 0.005 on test and on validation, grows if it rises by at least 0.005 on both, holds level if both changes are within 0.005, and is mixed otherwise.
reading.(2) repeated data: If a model's validation score at 360,000 updates is worse than its score at 180,000, it overfits the repeated mixture. The doubling is then read as a measure of repeated data, and no statement about more data is made from it.
reading.(3) the line: The gap at the four lengths against the base-2 logarithm of the updates, with its least-squares slope per doubling on each split: reported as a description, not as a claim.
reading.(4) one seed: No win is claimed from this record. If the stack is ahead on both splits with each paired interval below zero, a second seed of both models at 360,000 updates is registered before any claim.

what follows: If the gap keeps shrinking through the repeats, more distinct data for both models is the next step, and nothing is downloaded for it without Daniel's consent. If the repeats turn the gap or a model overfits, the data slope is read from the lengths before, and more distinct data comes before longer training.
where: PRIORITY 130, below every other job; each run alone on its GPU (MPS=0, GPU_MEM 85): the Transformer on GPU 0, the stack on GPU 1. A session that queues registered work ahead of them keeps them waiting. A job queued while one of them trains carries an AFTER line or a pin to the other GPU. If they cannot finish before the window closes on Thursday, they pause and go on in the standing windows.
seen_before_recording: Every result of the full-size records so far; of the data slope, fsd-st-180k's first-million scan at the reach of 8,192 (1.085103) and the trainers' curves of fsd-st-180k and fsd-tf-45k so far. No Transformer run at 180,000 updates has trained, and no run at 360,000 exists.
